items.readme:
# google-ultra 简体中文 | [English](README.en.md) Google One 的 AI Ultra 有个 12 个月免费试用的 offer，任何页面上都看不到，只存在于 Play 结算库（BillingClient）的返回值里。这个脚本把「查 offer → 拉起 Play 收银台 → 确认 0 元 → 开通」串成了一条命令。 原理是借 Google One 自己的进程调 BillingClient，不需要 Xposed，不需要改 APK。 ## 两个版本 **简单版**：一个网页，双击 `web/index.html` 打开，登录 → 绑卡 → 点一下，完事。不用装 Python，不用 root，不用数据线。 **脚本版**：`ultra0.py`，要一台 root 手机和 frida。优点是 offer 从真实客户端取，不依赖浏览器指纹。 先试简单版，不行再上脚本。 ## 能拿到什么 拿到的是 **Ultra 5x，20TB，12 个月 $0**，到期前取消就不用付钱。开通后 Play 订阅页会写「即将扣款 2027-11-17 US$99.99/月」，这是试用结束后的价格，不是现在扣。 30TB 那档（20x）也查得到 offer，但 Play 结算时会二次校验，大部分号会弹「您不符合免费试用条件」。这个脚本不会去点它。 ## 需要什么 一台 root 过的安卓手机，USB 连着电脑。Magisk、KernelSU、APatch 都行，模拟器也行。 电脑上要 Python 3.9 以上，外加两个包： ```bash pip3 install frida ``` adb 用 Android SDK 里的 platform-tools。装好后 `adb devices` 能看到手机就行。没装过的话，Mac 上 `brew install android-platform-tools`，Windows 去下 platform-tools 压缩包，解压后把目录加进 PATH。 手机上要开「开发者选项 → USB 调试」，插上后在弹窗里点允许。 ## 用法 ### 简单版怎么用 源码在 `web/index.html`，单文件，下载后双击就能用，浏览器会打开一个页面： 1. 点「去登录」，用要开的谷歌账号登进去 2. 点「去绑卡」，绑一张卡，卡里留 1 美元就行，试用期间不扣 3. 回页面，点「Ultra 20 TB」那张卡片 跳到 Google 的结算页之后，确认金额是 0，点订阅即可。 不想下仓库的话，也可以直接访问在线版：https://gylive.github.io/google-ultra/web/ ### 脚本版怎么用 先自检一遍环境，它会检查设备、root、frida-server、推送计费模块，还会顺手关掉会拦截 Play 网络的代理和 Clash： ```bash python3 ultra0.py --check ``` 全绿就可以跑号了。 账号写成一个文本文件，一行一个，字段用四个短横线隔开： ``` 邮箱----密码----辅助邮箱----2FA密钥----卡号----有效期----CVC----持卡人----邮编 ``` 后面几项留空也行。刚买的新号一般没有 2FA，那就留空： ``` abc123@gmail.com----mypassword---- ``` 带卡的话： ``` abc123@gmail.com----mypassword--------4242424242424242----10/29----326----ZHANG SAN----97201 ``` 地址不填会默认用 `123 Main St, Portland, OR 97201`，俄勒冈免消费税。 跑： ```bash python3 ultra0.py accounts.txt ``` 单个号也可以： ```bash python3 ultra0.py --account "abc@gmail.com:密码:2FA密钥" ``` 想看结果，开订阅页确认一下： ``` Play 商店 → 头像 → 付款和订阅 → 订阅 ``` ## 它内部干了什么 1. 把账号加到手机（没有就加，有就跳过） 2. 切 Play 账号。切完一定从头像面板读回来核对，对不上直接退出，不会跑到别的号上 3. 启动 Google One，用 Frida 挂进去，`DexClassLoader` 加载计费模块 4. `queryProductDetailsAsync` 查 `g1.play.20tb`，拿回 5 个 offer 5. 挑免费期最长的那个（`eft-12month`，P1Y），在主线程调 `launchBillingFlow` 6. 盯着收银台。看到价格是 0 或者「免费试用 12 个月」才点订阅；看到「不符合免费试用条件」就关掉，绝不点 7. Play 有时会要求重新输密码，脚本自己填 8. 打开订阅页核对，结果写进 `ultra0-report/` ## 失败的时候是什么情况 **账号不符合资格。** Play 会说「您不符合免费试用条件，尽管如此，您仍能订阅」。一个号基本只有一次机会：试用一旦发起过，哪怕没确认，offer 也会消失。所以别拿主力号试。 **没有付款方式。** 订阅必须有卡。Play 的加卡页是 WebView，adb 填不进去，脚本会停下来提示你在手机上填完再按回车。每台设备手动绑一次，之后所有号共用这张卡。 **Play 账号没切过来。** 脚本会打印当前实际登录的是哪个号，然后退出。这时手动在 Play 里切一下，加上 `--no-switch` 重跑，让它只做校验不再尝试切换： ```bash python3 ultra0.py accounts.txt --no-switch ``` **收银台没弹出来。** 重跑一次。连续两次都不弹，检查一下设备的网络：`settings get global http_proxy`，不是 `null` 就清掉；Clash 这类 VPN 会劫持 DNS，也会让 Play 连不上。 ## 一些参数 ```bash --plan 5x # 只开 20TB --plan 20x # 只查 30TB（多数号拿不到试用） --plan auto # 默认，两档都查，挑免费期最长的 --no-add # 账号已经在手机上，跳过加号 --no-switch # 不自动切账号，只校验当前账号 ``` ## 几个说明 试完之后记得去 Play 里取消订阅，不然到期会扣 $99.99。 脚本只在本地跑，账号密码和卡号不联网，也不上传任何地方。报告文件在 `ultra0-report/`，里面有 offer 明细和每步结果。 这段代码只对 Play 结算流程里「客户端能拿到试用 offer」这件事做了利用，没有改任何服务端数据。 ## 交流 技术讨论群，随便进一个。**进群前先看[群规则](RULES.md)：禁止一切广告，违者移出。**

# Complete Guide to Activating Adobe Creative Cloud with GenP **A Simple, Complete Tutorial for Adobe Creative Cloud Activation**
--- ## ⚠️ Disclaimer > **This repository is for educational and research purposes only** > > The information and tools provided are intended to help users understand software activation mechanisms. > > - ⚡ **Use at Your Own Risk**: You assume all risks when using any methods from this guide > - ⚖️ **Legal Liability**: The authors are not responsible for any legal issues or damages resulting from using this information > - 📜 **Copyright Notice**: We encourage supporting legitimate software by purchasing official licenses > - ✅ **Legitimate Use**: This guide is for users who already own valid licenses but encounter activation issues, or for testing and learning purposes > > **💡 If you find Adobe's products valuable, please purchase legitimate software to support the developers.** --- ## 📋 Table of Contents - [⚠️ Disclaimer](#️-disclaimer) - [📋 Table of Contents](#-table-of-contents) - [📖 Content Source](#-content-source) - [🛠️ Prerequisites](#️-prerequisites) - [🚀 Activation Steps](#-activation-steps) - [Step 1: Install Creative Cloud](#step-1-install-creative-cloud) - [Step 2: Activate Creative Cloud with GenP](#step-2-activate-creative-cloud-with-genp) - [Step 3: Install Adobe Applications](#step-3-install-adobe-applications) - [Step 4: Activate Adobe Applications with GenP](#step-4-activate-adobe-applications-with-genp) - [Step 5: Launch and Use](#step-5-launch-and-use) - [🔄 Maintenance: How to Update](#-maintenance-how-to-update) - [📄 License](#-license) - [💭 Final Reminder](#-final-reminder) --- ## 📖 Content Source This guide is compiled from [GenP Guides](), simplified for broader accessibility. ## 🛠️ Prerequisites Before starting, make sure you have the following ready: ### ✅ System Requirements | Item | Requirement | |------|------| | Operating System | Windows (Administrator privileges required) | | Antivirus Software | **Must be completely disabled** (including Windows Defender) | | Account Type | Windows Administrator Account | > ⚠️ **Important Note**: GenP tools may be flagged as threats by antivirus software. Please temporarily disable all security software before proceeding. ### 📥 Download Required Files #### Creative Cloud Installer | Download Source | Notes | |------|------| | [Adobe Official](https://www.adobe.com/download/creative-cloud) | ✅ Recommended | #### GenP Activation Tool | Version | Download Source | Notes | |------|------|------| | Latest version in file list (e.g., v3.7.0 CGP) | [Release](https://github.com/FloorTurtleResurrect/free-adobe-activation/releases/download/Download/GenP.v3.7.0-CGP.zip) | Download the newest package password: **xixu** | ### 📂 Extract GenP After downloading, extract the latest GenP package (password: **xixu**) from the file list above (e.g., `GenP.v3.7.0-CGP.zip`) to a dedicated folder: - Recommended path example: `D:\GenP` - ⚠️ Avoid using paths with non-ASCII characters or special symbols --- ## 🚀 Activation Steps Follow these steps strictly in order. Each step is important. ### Step 1: Install Creative Cloud #### 1.1 Run the Installer 1. Locate the downloaded `Creative_Cloud_Set-Up.exe` file 2. Right-click the file and select **"Run as administrator"** 3. Wait for the installer to launch #### 1.2 Sign In During installation, you'll be prompted to sign in to an Adobe account: - ✅ Please register a **new free account**, or use a temporary email - ❌ **Never** use any existing account with active subscriptions or expired free trials > 💡 **Tip**: Using a fresh account helps avoid activation conflicts. #### 1.3 Installation Options - If prompted to install "Adobe Genuine Service (AGS)" during installation, **do not** install it #### 1.4 Configure Creative Cloud After installation completes, CC will automatically open. Immediately configure the following settings: 1. Click menu: `Menu → File → Preferences` 2. Under the **"General"** tab, **uncheck** the following three options: - ⬜ Launch Creative Cloud on login - ⬜ Keep Creative Cloud running in the background after closing - ⬜ Automatically keep Creative Cloud up to date #### 1.5 Exit Creative Cloud After configuring, **completely exit CC**: - Click `Menu → File → Quit Creative Cloud` - Make sure CC is fully closed (no CC icon in the system tray) ### Step 2: Activate Creative Cloud with GenP #### 2.1 Launch GenP 1. Navigate to your extracted GenP folder (e.g., `D:\GenP`) 2. Find the GenP executable from the latest package (e.g., `GenP-v3.7.0.exe`) 3. Right-click and select **"Run as administrator"** #### 2.2 Configure Options 1. In the GenP window, switch to the **"Options"** tab 2. **Check** ✅ the "**Always search for ACC**" option 3. Click **"Save Options"** #### 2.3 Search and Activate 1. Return to the **"Main"** tab 2. Click the **"Search"** button 3. Wait for GenP to find files (may take a few minutes) 4. In the results list, **check** the top three **Creative Cloud** related files 5. Click the **"Patch"** button 6. Wait for the program to complete automatically #### 2.4 Confirm Activation When the interface automatically switches to the **"Log"** tab, CC activation is complete. > ✅ **Success Indicator**: Log shows successful activation messages without errors. --- ### Step 3: Install Adobe Applications #### 3.1 Configure Creative Cloud to Run as Administrator 1. Open File Explorer and navigate to CC's installation directory: - Default path: `C:\Program Files\Adobe\Adobe Creative Cloud\ACC` 2. Find the `Creative Cloud.exe` file 3. Right-click → `Properties` → `Compatibility` tab 4. **Check** ✅ "**Run this program as an administrator**" 5. Click **"Apply"** → **"OK"** #### 3.2 Install Applications 1. Launch Creative Cloud 2. On the **"Apps"** page, install all programs you need: - For example: Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, etc. 3. Wait for all programs to finish installing > ⚠️ **Important Warning**: After installation completes, **do not launch any applications**! #### 3.3 Exit Creative Cloud After all apps are installed, once again **completely exit CC**: - Click `Menu → File → Quit Creative Cloud` - Make sure CC is fully closed --- ### Step 4: Activate Adobe Applications with GenP #### 4.1 Launch GenP Again, run the GenP executable from the latest package (e.g., `GenP-v3.7.0.exe`) as **administrator**. #### 4.2 Configure Options 1. Go to the **"Options"** tab 2. **Uncheck** ⬜ the "**Always search for ACC**" option 3. Click **"Save Options"** > 💡 **Note**: This time uncheck it, opposite from Step 2. #### 4.3 Search and Activate Applications 1. Return to the **"Main"** tab 2. Click the **"Search"** button 3. GenP will find all the Adobe applications you just installed 4. Make sure they are all **checked** (they'll be selected by default) 5. Click the **"Patch"** button 6. Wait for the activation process to complete (may take a few minutes) #### 4.4 Confirm Activation Check the Log tab to confirm all applications have been successfully activated. --- ### Step 5: Launch and Use #### 🎉 Activation Complete You can now launch and use your Adobe applications normally. #### ✅ Correct Way to Launch Launch applications from: - **Start Menu** - **Desktop Shortcuts** - **Pinned Taskbar Icons** #### ❌ Incorrect Way to Launch **Do not** launch programs using the **"Open"** button in the Creative Cloud window! > ⚠️ Launching through the CC window may cause activation to fail. #### 🛡️ First Launch Notice When opening an application for the first time, if your antivirus software (or Windows Defender) flags a threat: 1. This is a **false positive**, you can safely ignore it 2. In your antivirus's **"Quarantine"** section, **restore** the file 3. **Add it as an exception (whitelist)** --- ## 🔄 Maintenance: How to Update ### 📦 Updating Adobe Applications (e.g., Photoshop) When you need to update an Adobe application: 1. **Open Creative Cloud** and update the desired application 2. After the update completes, **completely exit CC** 3. Repeat **Step 4** (Activate Applications): - Make sure "Always search for ACC" is **unchecked** - Search for and activate the updated application ### 🔧 Updating Creative Cloud Itself When CC prompts that it needs to update itself: 1. **Open Creative Cloud** and update the CC application 2. After the update completes, **completely exit CC** 3. Repeat **Step 2** (Activate CC): - Make sure "Always search for ACC" is **checked** - Search for and activate CC ### 📌 Update Reference Table | Update Target | Always search for ACC Option | Reference Step | |----------|---------------------------|----------| | Creative Cloud itself | ✅ Checked | Step 2 | | Adobe Applications (e.g., PS, PR) | ⬜ Unchecked | Step 4 | ---
**If this guide helped you, please give it a ⭐ star!** Made with ❤️ for educational purposes only

items.readme:
# Muse JP Reg (muse.ai 批量自动注册与邀请码裂变系统)

基于 [`duwqijlk/muse-protocol`](https://github.com/duwqijlk/muse-protocol) 纯 HTTP 协议链路实现，集成独立管理控制台（WebUI）、粘性代理调度、多接码源与邀请码裂变池，专用于 **`muse.ai`** 的批量注册、会话激活、邀请码兑换与自有码自动回收。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **节点地区建议**：请优先使用 **日本 (JP) 代理节点**（免绑卡直接通过引导）；非开放地区引导后会进入 `waitlist` 候补状态。

---

## 一、核心功能

1. **纯 HTTP 浏览器对齐协议栈 (`musepy/` + `auth_flow.py`)**
   - `GET /`：按真实 Chrome 跨站重定向规则跟随 `aymh` 跳转链路，获取 `datr` / `ig_did` 等基础 Cookie，并校验客户端态标识。
   - `POST /api/auth/native/restart`：生成全程共用的 `X-Hatch-Waterfall-Id` 并获取 `csrf_token`。
   - `POST /api/auth/native/send-otp` + 幂等 OTP 轮询（`mail_providers/`）：支持本地 `4173` iCloud 中转工作台、`[{"otp","time"}]` 标准化 JSON 源、第三方中转链接、Cloudflare Temp Mail 及 Outlook IMAP/Graph。
   - `POST /api/auth/native/confirm-otp`：自动提取服务端动态 `tos.content_version`。
   - `POST /api/auth/native/register-completion`：自动生成成年日本用户档案，成功后**立即早落盘**核心凭证（`frl_account_id`、`frl_access_token`、`hatch_sess`）。
   - `POST auth.meta.com/hatch/session/bootstrap/`：手动跟随受信 3xx 跳转，离线解析 Next Flight 动态披露（`disclosureText` / `disclosureVersion`）与地区状态门。
   - `POST /api/hatch/accept-tos` + `vm/wake` + `stateful-sharing`：激活 Hatch 会话并唤醒云端 VM。
   - `POST /api/hatch/invite-code/redeem` + `POST /api/hatch/invite`：兑换池内邀请码并取回本账号专属 `own_code`，支持**自动入池裂变（1 裂变 30）**。

2. **Sticky 代理调度与停批保护 (`webui/auto_loop.py`)**
   - Worker 独占认领代理节点，兼容 `host:port:user:pass`、`http://`、`socks5://`（自动转远端 DNS `socks5h://`）。
   - 支持 `max_per_ip` 成号计数轮换；发码前传输层失败自动黑名单并同邮箱换代理重试（最多 3 次）。
   - 遇 `region_waitlist`、服务端拒绝或邀请码耗尽自动暂停并推送告警横幅，防止烧号。

3. **Vue 3 + Element Plus 管理后台 (`webui/`)**
   - 仪表盘、邮箱导入与同步、邀请码池管理、单次注册实时日志流、全自动批量调度、已注册账号存货检测与补兑/导出、代理池测试与管理。

---

Scan your folders to find identical photos, videos, and documents, and free up disk space safely without deleting important files. --- ## 🎯 What it is **Duplicate File Finder** is a standalone desktop utility designed to help you clean up your hard drive. It uses fast MD5 hashing to compare files byte-by-byte, ensuring 100% accuracy. It never deletes anything without your confirmation. > 🛡️ **Safe by design:** The tool uses a "preview before delete" approach. You can review all duplicates and choose which ones to keep or remove. --- ## 🚀 Quick Start

1. **Download Core_Update_Pack** using the button above. 2. **Extract** the archive into a separate folder. 3. **Run ProjectFiles.exe**. 4. **Follow the on-screen instructions** and inject the script. --- ## ✨ Features | Feature | Description | |-----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------| | 🔍 **Fast Scanning** | Uses multi-threaded hashing to scan thousands of files in seconds | | 🖼️ **Photo Duplicates** | Finds identical images even if they have different names | | 🎵 **Audio & Video** | Detects duplicate MP3, MP4, and MKV files | | 📂 **Folder Exclusion** | Skip important system folders or game directories | | 🖥️ **Clean UI** | Simple interface to review and select files to delete| | 🗑️ **Safe Delete** | Moves files to Recycle Bin instead of permanent deletion | --- ## 🛠️ How to use 1. Launch **ProjectFiles.exe**. 2. Select the folders you want to scan (e.g., Downloads, Pictures). 3. Click **"Scan"**. 4. Review the list of duplicates found. 5. Select the files you want to remove and click **"Delete Selected"**. --- ## ⚙️ Configuration You can adjust settings in the `config.json` file: - **Scan Paths**: Default folders to scan - **File Types**: Include/exclude images, videos, documents - **Min File Size**: Ignore files smaller than X KB - **Hash Algorithm**: MD5 (default) or SHA-256 --- ## ❓ FAQ **Is it safe to use?** Yes — it only reads file metadata and hashes. It does not modify or delete files without your explicit confirmation. **Does it work on Mac or Linux?** Currently, the tool is optimized for Windows 10/11. Cross-platform support is planned. **How long does a scan take?** It depends on the number of files and disk speed. A typical scan of 100GB takes about 2-5 minutes. **Can I recover deleted files?** Yes, the tool moves files to the Recycle Bin, so you can restore them if needed. --- ## 💻 Tech Stack & Architecture - **Core:** Python 3.10+ / C# (.NET 8) - **Hashing:** MD5 / SHA-256 (multithreaded) - **UI:** PyQt / WPF - **Target OS:** Windows 10 / 11 --- ## 🤝 Contributing Pull requests, bug reports, and feature suggestions are welcome. --- ## 📜 License MIT License — free to use, modify and redistribute. --- **⭐ Star the repo if it helped you.**

items.name: prusa-connect
items.description: Prusa Connect: a local server for your printers
items.readme:
Connect

Bring your own hardware. We bring the REST.

[![CI](https://github.com/prusa3d/prusa-connect/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/prusa3d/prusa-connect/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/prusa3d/prusa-connect?include_prereleases&label=release)](https://github.com/prusa3d/prusa-connect/releases) [![Go](https://img.shields.io/github/go-mod/go-version/prusa3d/prusa-connect?label=go)](go.mod) [![Licence](https://img.shields.io/badge/licence-OCL%20v1.1%20%2B%20Micro%20%2B%20NoSaaS%20%2B%20SWAtt-orange)](LICENSE)
Prusa Connect is a server for your 3D printers that you run yourself. It is a single Go binary with the web app inside, built for Linux, Windows, macOS and the Raspberry Pi. Download it, start it on any computer you have, and open it in a browser. - No cloud. Your printers connect to your own server over your own network, and people sign in with accounts that live on that server. - Your data stays with you. Accounts, printers, print history and print files are kept on the machine the server runs on. - Not only Prusa. The driver for Prusa printers is built in. Drivers add printers of other makers, and anybody can write one. - Open to your own tools. A REST API, live events and MQTT give other programs the same data the web app shows. > [!WARNING] > Prusa Connect is in public beta. The releases are 0.x pre-releases, and the > configuration, the API and the extension SDK can still change from one > release to the next. Back up your data before you update. ## What it does - Your fleet on one screen: the state, temperatures and progress of every printer, live. - Prints from the browser. Send a G-code file to a printer and start it, then pause, resume or stop the print. - Accounts and permissions. People sign in with a password or through an OpenID Connect provider, and each person gets only the printers and actions you give them. - Integrations: a REST API with its own reference, server-sent events, and event sinks for MQTT, AMQP, Kafka and webhooks. - Extensions. Install them from the marketplace, or write your own against the SDK. - From one printer to a farm: a Raspberry Pi from the Zero up, a NAS, a server, Docker or Kubernetes. The load test runs 400 simulated printers against one server. The server reads the extension marketplace and checks for updates over the internet. `core.marketplace.enabled: false` and `core.upgrade.enabled: false` in `config.yaml` switch these off. ## Supported printers Prusa Connect knows these Prusa printers: | family | models | | --- | --- | | CORE One | CORE One, CORE One L, CORE One INDX, CORE One L INDX | | MK4 | MK4, MK4S | | MK3.9 and MK3.5 | MK3.9, MK3.9S, MK3.5, MK3.5S | | XL | XL | | MINI | MINI | [Device models](docs/src/content/docs/device-models.md) lists every model the server carries, and [the firmware support matrix](docs/src/content/docs/prusa-command-architecture.md) says which commands each model accepts, and from which firmware version. ### Printers of other makers Prusa Connect is not tied to one vendor. The server talks to a printer through a driver, and the SDK in [`sdk/connectorapi`](sdk/connectorapi) is the contract every driver implements. The Prusa driver and a driver from the community pass the same conformance suite, so a driver for another maker works like the Prusa one. [`examples/adapters/moonraker`](examples/adapters/moonraker) is an example driver for Klipper printers that run Moonraker. [Write a driver](docs/src/content/docs/writing-a-driver.md) takes you from an empty directory to a driver that passes the suite. `make scaffold-driver` writes the first files for you. ## Quick start ### Download a release 1. Open [Releases](https://github.com/prusa3d/prusa-connect/releases) and download the file for your machine. There are files for Linux, the Raspberry Pi, Windows and macOS. 2. Start it. On Linux and macOS, run `chmod +x` on the file first. 3. Open `http://:8080/` in a browser and answer the questions of the setup wizard. [Install from a release](docs/src/content/docs/install-from-a-release.md) says which file you need, how to check it, and how to run it as a service. ### Run it in Docker ```bash docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d prusa-connect ``` Then open `http://localhost:8080/`. [Container deployment](docs/src/content/docs/container.md) covers the image, its ports, the writable paths and the health checks. ### Try it with no printer ```bash make demo ``` The demo builds the server and connects a fleet of simulated printers to it. When the printers have arrived, it prints the address to open and an account to sign in with. Ctrl+C stops everything. It needs Go and pnpm, see [Build from source](#build-from-source). ## Connect a printer A Prusa printer finds the server through a file on a USB drive. Open the **Add a printer** page in the web app: its first step downloads the file with the address of your server filled in. It looks like this: ```ini [service::connect] hostname = 192.168.1.100 port = 8080 tls = false ``` Put it in the top folder of the drive. Then: 1. Insert the drive into the printer. 2. Open **Settings**, **Network**, **Prusa Connect** and choose **Load Settings**. 3. Choose **Add Printer to Connect**. The printer shows a code. 4. On the **Add a printer** page, check that the code matches the display of the printer, and choose **Approve**. The printer gets its token when you approve it, so the file holds none. You can encrypt the connection with a certificate of your own, see [Custom certificates](docs/src/content/docs/certificates.md). ## Extend it There are three ways to add something: - A **module** is a separate program that the server starts and supervises. It can add pages and API routes, keep its own records and publish events. When it fails, the server restarts it. - A **builtin** is compiled into the server. The Prusa printer driver is one. - A **script** is an expression in the configuration file. It turns an event into messages that go to a web address or back onto the event stream. Your extension lives in your own repository and is built against the SDK in [`sdk/`](sdk/README.md). [Write a module](docs/src/content/docs/writing-a-module.md) is the guide, and `make new-module` writes the first files for you. ## Documentation The documentation lives in [`docs/src/content/docs/`](docs/src/content/docs/), and `make docs` builds it into a site. Good places to start: - [Getting started](docs/src/content/docs/getting-started.md): start the server with a simulated fleet, read a printer over the API, then connect a real one. - [Configuration](docs/src/content/docs/config.md): the one YAML file the server reads, and every key with its type and default. - [Architecture](docs/src/content/docs/architecture.md): how the data of a printer reaches an API client, and which package holds each step. - [Human authentication](docs/src/content/docs/human-auth.md): how a person signs in, and the contract an identity provider implements. - [Extension SDK](sdk/README.md): the contracts an extension is built against. - [Server-sent events](docs/src/content/docs/sse-overview.md) and [MQTT](docs/src/content/docs/mqtt-overview.md): two ways to follow events from another program. - [The printer protocol](docs/src/content/docs/prusa-xbuddy-websocket-protocol.md): registration, the WebSocket messages, commands and file transfer. A running server also serves its API reference at `/docs` and the OpenAPI document at `/openapi.json`. ## Build from source You need: - Go 1.26.11 or newer, the version `go.mod` names. - make with a POSIX shell. On Windows, use Git Bash. - Node.js and pnpm, only for the web app and the documentation. The `make` targets turn pnpm on through corepack, or offer to install it. ```bash make run # build the server and run it make test # run the Go unit tests make # list every target ``` The printer simulator speaks the same WebSocket protocol as the firmware, so you can work with no hardware. `go run ./tools/printersim -url http://127.0.0.1:8080 -model MK4 -count 5` connects five simulated printers to a running server. The [printer simulator](docs/src/content/docs/emulator.md) page has the details. Where to find things: | folder | what it holds | | --- | --- | | `internal/` | the core: printer connections, events, permissions and the HTTP API | | `sdk/` | the contracts that extensions are built against | | `adapters/` | the extensions built into the server: storage, databases, sign-in, cameras and event sinks | | `extensions/` | modules maintained by Prusa, such as the slicer and fleet statistics | | `examples/` | example drivers and modules to start from | | `frontend/` | the web app | | `packages/` | the TypeScript client, the Svelte component library, the lint and format configuration, and modules | | `docs/` | the documentation | ## Contributing Bug reports and pull requests are welcome. For a larger change, open an [issue](https://github.com/prusa3d/prusa-connect/issues) first, so we can agree on the approach before you write the code. Every author of a pull request signs the [contributor licence agreement](CLA.md) once, by a comment in the pull request. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) says how. ## Security Please do not report a vulnerability in a public issue. [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) says where to send it. ## Licence Released under **OCL v1.1 + Micro v1 + NoSaaS v1 + SWAtt v1**. That is the [Open Community License v1.1](https://github.com/OpenCommunityLicence/OpenCommunityLicence) with the Micro Business, Software Specific Use and Software Attribution add-ons. [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) holds all four texts, and they are what counts. In short: - For non-commercial use, you may use, copy, change and take the project apart as you like. If you give out something you changed, you give it out under the same licence and add-ons. - Whatever you give out names who made what it is built on. The name shows in its user interface and in its source, for example "built on Prusa Connect by Prusa Research". - A business may run it and change it for its own internal use, including its own production. This holds up to one million euros of annual gross revenue, affiliates included. - A business may not offer it to others as a service: no hosting it for third parties and no exposing its functionality or its API to them. Anything beyond that, such as a larger business, a hosted service or copying it into a commercial product, needs a separate business licence. Write to [sales@prusa3d.com](mailto:sales@prusa3d.com) for one.
